item.title: A wet and windy week, but less impactful than of late - Somali Mail
item.description: However, further areas of low pressure will continue to track eastwards across the Atlantic through this week. These systems are set to slow as they encounter a blocking area of high pressure over eastern Europe, resulting in additional spells of rain, particularly in the southwest, as well as hill snow across parts of northeast Scotland.
